US Congressman Resigns Amid Sexual Misconduct Allegations

US Representative Jimmy Gomez has announced his resignation following a report by the House Ethics panel that found "substantial evidence" of sexual misconduct. Gomez stated he had "no other alternative" but to resign. The Los Angeles Times reported that the ethics panel found evidence of sexual misconduct, leading to Gomez's decision to quit.
